subject: BOX-002c drift: my own flag seed blocked the deploy, and the obvious fix would have broken production
description: RESOLVED 2026-09-06, recorded because the near-miss is the lesson. Deploying the BUG-262 rules fix was BLOCKED by the smoke gate: BOX-002c walkthrough-to-box_flags drift, 1 box, pis-m2-vault-breach, 8 items, deploy-blocking. IT WAS MINE. Commit 408012ebe (the BUG-260 four-lab flag seed earlier the same session) added pis-m2-vault-breach to functions/box_flags.json keyed flag1..flag4, while the walkthrough's '## 7. Flag Values' table keyed the same four flags 1..4. The flag VALUES were byte-identical; only the scenario IDs disagreed, so the validator counted 4 walkthrough-only + 4 seed-only. THE OBVIOUS FIX WOULD HAVE BROKEN PRODUCTION. Renaming the seed keys to 1..4 to match the walkthrough looks right and is wrong: the box's own config.js calls awardFlag('flag1')..awardFlag('flag4') and declares id:'flag1', so flag1..flag4 IS the runtime contract and the Cloud Function reads those keys to validate a captured flag. Changing them would have silently stopped awarding flags for that box. Checked before touching anything: 242 of 246 seeded boxes use ids that match their own box's ids (cell-sigma uses stage1_firstlight etc.), and the only 4 using a flagN style are the 4 I seeded -- which is not a deviation, it is those boxes' actual ids. FIX WAS IN THE WALKTHROUGH, NOT THE SEED AND NOT THE VALIDATOR: section 7's table first column now carries the runtime ids (flag1..flag4) instead of display numbers, and a '## 11. Flag Manifest' section states the mapping explicitly in the same 3-column form PIS-FINAL-Patient-Zero uses -- the box the validator's own self-validation cites as the known-good precedent for a flag1..flagN seed. Original archived as PIS-M2-Vault-Breach-SOLUTION.md.pre-flag-manifest-2026-09-06.bak. RESULT: drift 1 -> 0, clean boxes 120 -> 121, validator self-validation still PASS on its 3 known-good cases, i.e. detection strength unchanged because the validator was never touched. I did NOT use SKIP_SMOKE. A gate firing is information; the gate caught a regression I had shipped hours earlier and would otherwise have discovered from a student not being awarded a flag.
